title: Fixed-scalar coefficient inputs and witnessed refinement maps
statement: At positive coefficient level n+1, put A=ULift(O_E/(t^(n+1))). On the fixed-scalar pro-etale derived category define boundedConstructible and finiteTor by pulling back the intrinsic predicates through sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence. For f:X→Y let tensorInput(K,L)=K tensor Lf*L and image(c)=Rp_*j_!. For an origin O and an actual isomorphism e:fixed(O)≅K, theta(r,K,O,e) is image(c).mapIso(e.symm), followed by the specified refinementComparisonAtWitness, followed by image(d).mapIso(e). The source and target bifunctors restrict the two sides of the actual projection transformation to the full bounded-constructible/finite-Tor input category. refinementLaw asserts PF_c followed by theta on the tensor equals the tensor of theta on K with identity_L followed by PF_d, for every pair of retained witnesses. The coefficientImage, coefficientProjectionSource and coefficientProjectionTarget abbreviations are exactly the native functors at a generic commutative ring. The displayed projection is the existing finiteProjection, definitionally the native projectionMapOfCompactification; generic packaging fixes the categorical instances before substituting ULift(O_E/(t^(n+1))). coefficientProjectionComponent is the evaluation of that same finiteProjection at K,L, with the tensor-image source and image-tensor target declared explicitly before coefficient specialization; it defines no different map.
